# SVG clip union references

Three unmodified WPT files at the commit pinned in sources.json exercise two child silhouettes with nonzero/nonzero, nonzero/evenodd and evenodd/evenodd rules. Their published reference SVGs, SHA-256 values and BSD-3-Clause LICENSE are preserved. The browser harness fixes both original and reference viewports to 256×256 with viewBox 0 0 200 200; it does not edit these files.

The 32 generated opposite-direction cases come from compatibility/runs/2026-09-05-svg-next-clip-unions.json; twelve additional matrices transform independent explicit expected union contours. User originals remain private local inputs and are not redistributed here.
